pages.title: Plants of Gensokyo
pages.text: Many of the pot's recipes rely on plants unique to Gensokyo: Ghost Fire, Dream, and Demonic Miasma mushrooms, found on their great mushroom trees, along with wild Star Flowers and Flame Cattails.

Keep a variety of ingredients on hand. Many recipes combine several different plants, sometimes alongside familiar materials such as powders and monster drops. JEI lists the exact ingredients for every Alchemy Pot recipe.
